legal_basis.claim: Распоряжение Минприроды России от 25.09.2026 № 58-р — перечни муниципальных образований и видов отходов I/II классов для особого режима накопления и хранения
legal_basis.implementing_context: ПП РФ от 24.07.2025 № 1093, изменившее ПП РФ № 1305 и предусматривающее перечни в составе федеральной схемы

scope: Only types of I–II hazardous waste and municipalities expressly on the lists; do not generalize to all territories or waste classes.
diagnostic_checks: municipality and official OKTMO identifier must be on official list
FKKO code and I–II class must be on list
verify contract with federal operator where required
verify 24-month accumulation ceiling and separately storage requirements
check exact effective date, full annexes and amended federal scheme
do not grant special storage rights by analogy
promotion_gate: obtain authentic complete order with annexes and entry-into-force
extract complete municipalities and FKKO IDs
cross-compare Hard Radar source records and Engine current rules
regression test applicability including nonlisted municipality/waste
promote only verified requirements without overwriting other rules
verification: сигнал есть, подтверждение не найдено — не публиковать как факт
